# SILVA stuff

```{r}

  separate(Taxon, c("Domain","Phylum", "Class", "Order",
                    "Family", "Genus", "Species"), sep = ";", remove = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#Import SILVA taxonomy
SILVA_taxonomy <- read.delim("~/Documents/GitHub/HPRC_data/taxonomy_SILVA.tsv")

df_SILVA_taxonomy <- rename(SILVA_taxonomy, `FeatureID` = `Feature.ID`) %>% 
  separate(Taxon, c("Domain","Phylum", "Class", "Order",
                    "Family", "Genus", "Species"), sep = ";", remove = FALSE)
```


```{r}
silva_taxa <- df_SILVA_taxonomy %>% 
  select(FeatureID, Domain, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species)
```


```{r}
new_mergeSILVA2 <- full_join(new_merged, silva_taxa, by = "FeatureID")

new_mergeSILVA3 <- new_mergeSILVA2 %>% 
 # mutate(taxon_final = if_else(is.na(Taxon.x), Taxon.y, Taxon.x)) %>% 
  mutate(domain_final = if_else(is.na(Domain.x), Domain.y, Domain.x)) %>% 
  mutate(phylum_final = if_else(is.na(Phylum.x), Phylum.y, Phylum.x)) %>% 
  mutate(class_final = if_else(is.na(Class.x), Class.y, Class.x)) %>% 
  mutate(order_final = if_else(is.na(Order.x), Order.y, Order.x)) %>% 
    mutate(family_final = if_else(is.na(Family.x), Family.y, Family.x)) %>% 
  mutate(genus_final = if_else(is.na(Genus.x), Genus.y, Genus.x)) %>%
  mutate(species_final = if_else(is.na(Species.x), Species.y, Species.x))
```


```{r}
new_mergeSILVA4 <- new_mergeSILVA3 %>% 
  select(FeatureID, SAMPLE, domain_final, supergroup_final, phylum_final, class_final, order_final, family_final, genus_final, species_final, LOCATION, SITE, SAMPLETYPE, DEPTH, DEPTH_CATEGORY, FLUID_COLLECTION, vent_endemic, filter, VentField, total_sequences, merged_sampleid)
```


```{r}
vent_asvs <- new_mergeSILVA4 %>%
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(SAMPLETYPE) == 1, SAMPLETYPE == "vent") %>%
  ungroup()

test_vent_asvs_info <- new_merged %>%
  filter(SAMPLETYPE == "vent") %>% 
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(
    also_in_other_st = any(SAMPLETYPE != "vent")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


silva_asvs_info <- new_mergeSILVA4 %>%
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(
    in_vent= any(SAMPLETYPE == "vent"),
    also_in_other_st = any(SAMPLETYPE != "vent")
  ) %>%
  filter(in_vent) %>%  # keep only ASVs present in Lake
  ungroup()

silva_asvsInfor <- silva_asvs_info %>% 
  filter(also_in_other_st == FALSE)

length(unique(silva_asvsInfor$FeatureID))

silventonly_asv <- new_mergeSILVA4 %>% left_join(silva_asvsInfor) %>% 
  drop_na(in_vent)

length(unique(silventonly_asv$FeatureID))

#asvs_vent <- asvs_info %>%
#  mutate(
 #   status = case_when(
  #    in_vent & !also_in_other_st ~ "vent only",
   #   in_vent &  also_in_other_st ~ "nonvent",
   #   TRUE                           ~ "nonvent"
   # )
 # )

silvasvs_vent <- silva_asvs_info %>%
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      is.na(in_vent) == TRUE ~ "vent",
      in_vent == TRUE & also_in_other_st == FALSE ~ "resident",
      in_vent == TRUE & also_in_other_st == TRUE ~ "cosmopolitan",
      in_vent == FALSE ~ "cosmopolitan"
    )
  )

length(unique(asvs_vent$FeatureID))

silva_actual <- new_mergeSILVA4 %>% left_join(silvasvs_vent) %>% 
  mutate(status = case_when(SAMPLETYPE %in% c("plume", "background") ~ "cosmopolitan",
      TRUE ~ status))
```




```{r}
class_silva <- new_mergeSILVA4 %>%
  mutate(Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(species_final), "Unknown_Annotation", species_final)) %>%
  unite(PHYLUM_CLASS, phylum_final, class_final, sep = ": ", remove = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(PHYLUM_CLASS, FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(total_sequences = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE),
            Species_Annotation = first(Species_Annotation),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(PHYLUM_CLASS) %>%
  summarise(
    everything_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
    everything_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE),
    amount_all_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"),
    amount_all_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

class_silva_vent <- silventonly_asv %>%
  mutate(Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(species_final), "Unknown_Annotation", species_final)) %>%
  unite(PHYLUM_CLASS, phylum_final, class_final, sep = ": ", remove = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(PHYLUM_CLASS, FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(total_sequences = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE),
            Species_Annotation = first(Species_Annotation),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(PHYLUM_CLASS) %>%
  summarise(
    endemic_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
    endemic_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE),
    amount_end_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"),
    amount_end_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

class_silva_end_ev <- class_silva %>%
  left_join(class_silva_vent, by = "PHYLUM_CLASS")

total_seqs <- sum(class_silva_end_ev$everything_total_sequences)
total_asvs <- sum(class_silva_end_ev$everything_total_asvs)

class_math_silva_end_ev <- class_silva_end_ev %>%
  mutate(percent_endemic_asvs = endemic_total_asvs / everything_total_asvs) %>% 
  mutate(percent_endemic_seqs = endemic_total_sequences / everything_total_sequences) %>% 
  mutate(percent_NA_end_asvs = amount_end_asvs_NAs / endemic_total_asvs) %>% 
  mutate(percent_NA_all_asvs = amount_all_asvs_NAs / everything_total_asvs) %>% 
  mutate(percent_NA_end_seqs = amount_end_seqs_NA / endemic_total_sequences) %>% 
  mutate(percent_NA_all_seqs = amount_all_seqs_NA / everything_total_sequences) %>% 
  mutate(percent_all_asvs_of_total = everything_total_asvs / total_asvs) %>% 
  mutate(percent_all_seqs_of_total = everything_total_sequences / total_seqs) 

class_silva_end_ev_combined_table <- class_math_silva_end_ev %>% 
  dplyr::select(PHYLUM_CLASS,everything_total_asvs, endemic_total_asvs, everything_total_sequences, endemic_total_sequences, amount_all_asvs_NAs, amount_end_asvs_NAs, amount_all_seqs_NA, amount_end_seqs_NA, percent_endemic_asvs, percent_endemic_seqs, percent_NA_end_asvs, percent_NA_all_asvs, percent_NA_end_seqs, percent_NA_all_seqs,percent_all_asvs_of_total, percent_all_seqs_of_total)

# --- Step 5: Safety check ---
#stopifnot(all(class_math_silva_end_ev$percent_endemic_seqs <= 1))

# --- Step 6: View and save ---
view(class_math_silva_end_ev)
write_csv(class_silva_end_ev_combined_table, "~/Documents/GitHub/AXMCR/SILVA_class_math_end_ev.csv")

```
